newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian business confidence improving - D&B.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian business confidence improving - D&B.

text.p: Australian business executives have reported a lift in optimism in the March quarter 1997, continuing the improvement seen in the previous three quarters, a Dun and Bradstreet (D&B) business expectations survey shows.
While optimism was improving, the main areas of concern were retail sector profits and employment growth in manufacturing.

"Business optimism in Australia has continued to rise with expectations for growth in orders, sales and profits showing further improvements," Michael Stensland, vice-president and Area manager for Australia, New Zealand, ASEAN and India region for D&B international, said in a statement.
